messages:
rachel: Sketching a different angle on the pin/rollout metadata: treat pins as a compact alias + explicit provenance bundle. Want to avoid silent mismatches when underlying artifacts change. Posting the idea before a formal RFC.

morgan: Short and practical. What goes in the provenance bundle?

rachel: Minimal fields: artifact fingerprint (algo+hash), optional lineage list, and a few short namespaced hints like `t:tok-v2` or `q:q4_0`. Keep the runtime path tiny by exposing a `pin_ref` in high-QPS flows; admin APIs carry full bundle.

sanjay: Lineage helps explain "why a fallback was chosen" in traces. Also propose a small `decay` policy for ephemeral pins used in experiments: either expires_at or max_hits.

oliver: Important: define pin precedence clearly. I suggest request > route > tenant > org. Also add `origin` tag so we can attribute telemetry.

nina: For compatibility tags, require a short prefix (namespace) to prevent drift: `t:` tokenizer, `q:` quant, `k:` kvcache. That keeps storage lean.

rachel: Runtime contract: if provenance.fingerprint exists, resolver treats it as authoritative. If missing, resolver falls back to alias resolution and attaches `legacy_pin` flag in telemetry. For strict pins, mismatch => return 409 with structured payload.

morgan: Add `migration_mode` per-pin: ["manual","suggest","auto"]. Default manual. Suggest only applies to soft/sticky pins. Auto only for soft pins above compatibility score threshold.

sanjay: We should also record `lineage_distance` in telemetry and `chosen_candidate` hash + reason string (e.g., "tokenizer-mismatch"). That helps ops and product when tuning thresholds.

oliver: DB plan: store expanded provenance proto server-side. Admin UI uses compact JSON when creating. We'll need a backfill job to compute fingerprints for legacy pins; ambiguous cases become `legacy_soft` and emit admin alerts.

ci-bot: CI: branch rachel/pin-provenance -> pin-schema-tests flaky (timeout). Full log at https://ci.redwood.example/5678

rachel: I'll re-run and attach flaky test info to RFC. Action items we agreed: open RFC with schema examples + migration runbook (rachel), resolver prototype + tests for strict vs soft (morgan/sanjay), UI mock and admin alerts (nina), create backfill ticket (infra).

morgan: Quick note: keep pin objects small in admin payloads. Use namespaced tags and limit lineage to N recent hops. We'll sketch concrete limits in the RFC.

rachel: Will do. Posting draft by EOD. If anyone has objections to the enum names or tag prefixes, reply here.
